project.name: S.V. Fermi PWA
project.purpose: Afgeschermde ledenapp voor leden, commissies en bestuur van S.V. Fermi.

stack.backend: Firebase Authentication + Cloud Firestore + Firebase Storage

screens.reference: Approved Agenda mockup: compact dark navy header, paper-plane/calendar collage, five pill filters, orange featured event card, cream compact event cards with photographic right-side imagery.
Fermi overview preserves approved mockup: exactly three board preview cards, then committees and documents. Full board lives on /fermi/bestuur/.
Community is a hub with Leden and Fotoalbums tabs. Members stay on /community/; albums live on /community/fotoalbums/.
Approved profile mockup: collage header, member summary, digital member card with QR placeholder, member stats and My Fermi settings list.
Approved event detail master now includes a rich study-trip variant matching the Budapest ’25 mockup: collage hero, travel facts, 2x2 practical grid, registration/share actions and expectations.
Full five-person board detail page; overview remains visually compact.
Committee detail pages with description, activities, skills, fit, time commitment and signup CTA.
Photo album overview with Community tabs, search, category filters and collage-style album cards.
Approved Fermi login mockup: navy editorial collage, cream auth card, email/password login, password reset and Google/HvA sign-in.
Admin-only member administration with searchable member roster, lifecycle status/role controls, single-member entry and CSV import.
Admin-only Activities CRM for creating, editing, filtering, publishing/hiding and visually configuring agenda activities with reusable background presets.
Admin-only Mededelingen CRM for creating, editing, scheduling, pinning, publishing and hiding member announcements shown on Home.
Activity QR validation scanner for active committee, board and admin accounts. Scans digital member-card QR codes and validates active membership plus an active event registration.

design_system.master_reference: Approved dark-theme mockups are the visual master. Agenda must closely follow the supplied mockup composition, spacing, orange/cream/navy palette, collage header and photographic event cards.

preferred_structure.agenda: public/images/agenda/ (activity container images in public/images/agenda/activities/container-images/; detail page images in public/images/agenda/activities/detail-images/)

decisions: App is members-only in product scope.
Mobile-first PWA.
Dark Fermi theme is current visual master.
Stock placeholder images are acceptable until custom artwork is created.
GitHub Pages is used for the current static development deployment.
Routes and assets must remain compatible with /Fermi-PWA/.
Agenda event cards use relevant stock photography as temporary imagery until final Fermi artwork is available.
Agenda events use one canonical typed data source in data/agenda-events.ts.
Agenda event detail routes are statically generated for GitHub Pages compatibility.
Study-trip event details use a dedicated travel visual variant within the shared /agenda/[slug]/ route.
Studiereis Budapest ’25 exists as a hidden-from-November-overview demo/detail route at /agenda/studiereis-budapest-25/.
Fermi primary tab is implemented at /fermi/.
Fermi page sections are Bestuur, Commissies and Documenten using the approved dark editorial collage visual language.
Community primary tab is implemented at /community/.
Community member search and filters are interactive client-side.
Community member data is loaded from a privacy-safe Firestore communityMembers projection; private fields such as email, phone number and city are not exposed to the Community screen.
Leden admin synchronizes active member roster data into communityMembers so the Community count and member list stay current.
Profile primary tab is implemented at /profiel/.
Digital member card currently uses prototype member data and a visual QR placeholder.
Profile navigation is linked from all implemented primary screens and event detail pages.
Fermi overview must not expand the complete board inline; it previews three roles to preserve the approved mockup.
Full board information is routed to /fermi/bestuur/.
Agenda month selector is interactive client-side and supports month/year rollover.
Agenda overview only renders events matching the selected month and year, with an empty-month state when no events exist.
Fermi committee tiles are fully clickable and route to /fermi/commissies/[slug]/.
Committee data is centralized in data/committees.ts.
Committee signup buttons use local prototype state until a backend/member workflow is connected.
Community uses top-level Leden and Fotoalbums tabs so photo albums are not buried below the long member list.
Photo albums live at /community/fotoalbums/ and use centralized prototype data from data/photo-albums.ts.
Home uses uploaded local artwork from public/images/home/ for the hero church collage, featured borrel illustration and digital member pass atom artwork.
Home artwork filenames are home-hero-church.png, home-featured-borrel.png and home-member-pass-atom.png.
Firebase is the selected backend: Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Storage.
Authentication providers are Email/Password and Google.
Firestore region is EU.
Authentication identifies the account; Firestore user status and membership determine Fermi access.
New authenticated users bootstrap as role member with status pending; board/admin activation is separate.
Backend domain models live in lib/models/backend.ts and Firebase access is isolated in lib/services.
Firestore collections planned: users, memberships, events, registrations, committees, announcements, notifications and appConfig.
Login route /login/ uses Firebase Email/Password and Google authentication while preserving static GitHub Pages compatibility.
Profile shows Leden admin only to active users with role admin.
Member administration supports lifecycle states active, pending/in overgang, suspended and archived; linked accounts update users/memberships while imported members live in memberDirectory.
Bulk member import uses CSV with comma or semicolon separators and common Dutch/English column names.
Leden admin beheert naast naam/e-mail ook telefoonnummer, woonplaats en startjaar; deze velden worden meegenomen in handmatige invoer, detailbewerking en CSV-import.
Activiteiten admin is een CRM op /profiel/activiteiten-admin/ waarmee admins activiteiten kunnen toevoegen, bewerken, zoeken, filteren en publiceren/verbergen.

Activiteitafbeeldingen zijn opgesplitst in public/images/agenda/activities/container-images/ voor Agenda-cards en public/images/agenda/activities/detail-images/ voor detailpagina-hero's. Tijdens dev/build genereert scripts/generate-agenda-image-manifest.mjs automatisch twee selectorlijsten in data/agenda-images.generated.ts.

De Activities CRM bewaart alleen imagePath en detailImagePath op het activity-document; de app bouwt daar onder /Fermi-PWA de uiteindelijke asset-URL van. Dit houdt repository-assets en Firestore-data gescheiden.
Nieuwe activiteiten worden als ActivityData naar Firestore collection activities geschreven en verschijnen via dezelfde service in de Agenda.

Activiteiten zijn niet meer hardcoded in de repository: Firestore collection activities is de enige activity-datasource voor Agenda, Home/Binnenkort, Home/Volgende activiteit, Activities CRM en detailpagina's.
Activity detail navigation gebruikt de statische route /agenda/activiteit/?slug=<slug>, zodat nieuwe Firestore-activiteiten op GitHub Pages geen vooraf gegenereerde hardcoded slug-route nodig hebben.

Mededelingen worden beheerd via /profiel/mededelingen-admin/ en opgeslagen in Firestore collection announcements. Home leest alleen gepubliceerde mededelingen binnen hun start/einddatum; hardcoded Home-mededelingen zijn verwijderd.
QR-scanner is beschikbaar voor actieve commissie-, bestuurs- en adminaccounts via /profiel/qr-scanner/.
QR-validatie gebruikt de bestaande digitale ledenpas cardId en registrations-koppeling; activity-data wordt niet gedupliceerd in het membership-document.

De eerste scanner-versie is alleen validatie: groen bij actieve ledenpas + status registered voor de gekozen activiteit; rood bij ontbrekende inschrijving of ongeldige/inactieve pas. Aanwezigheidsregistratie en betaling volgen later.

Verified users with a pending membership may browse Home, Agenda, Fermi and their own Profile. Private member features stay locked until approval: Community/member directory, photo albums, event registration, committee signup and the digital member pass.

Active admins receive a persistent Home banner for pending member approvals. Clicking opens the shared notification overlay with all pending applications; selecting one deep-links to that member in Leden admin via ?member=<uid>.

Leden admin member rows prioritize payment attention: unpaid members use an orange hatched/high-attention state with a prominent 'Niet betaald' badge; waived memberships use a desaturated dark blue-gray low-attention state; paid members remain visually neutral with a subtle paid badge.

When an admin marks a pending account as paid or waived, membership and user state are written atomically: pending promotes to active. Changing payment on an already-active unpaid member does not automatically demote the membership back to pending.

SessionProvider listens realtime to the signed-in user's Firestore profile. A membership transition from pending to active immediately unlocks member-only UI/data without refresh or re-login and shows a short approval confirmation on Home.
